name: Pushbutton (6 mm tactile)
description: Momentary 4-leg tactile switch. Legs 1a/1b are always connected, as are 2a/2b; pressing connects side 1 to side 2. Pair it with INPUT_PULLUP and GND for the simplest wiring.
footprint: THT 6×6 mm tactile switch, 6.5 × 4.5 mm leg spacing

bindings.description: True while the button is held down.
SVG transform for the cap: "translate(0 0)" up, "translate(0 1.5)" pressed.
